sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
jina: Procedure for legislation concerning financial matters
maudhui: (1) The National Assembly shall not deal with any matter to which this Article applies unless the President has recommended that the matter be dealt with by the National Assembly and the President's recommendation has been submitted to the National Assembly by a Minister. (2) The matters to which this Article applies are: (a) a Bill for any of the following purposes - (i) imposing taxation or altering taxation otherwise than by reduction; (ii) providing for the payment or expenditure of money out of the Consolidated Fund or any other Government fund, or altering the amount otherwise than by reduction; (iii) providing for payment or expenditure out of the Consolidated Fund or any other Government fund where money in those funds has not been appropriated for that payment or expenditure, or providing for an increase in such payment or expenditure; (iv) cancelling or remitting any debt due to the Government of the United Republic; and (b) any motion or amendment to a motion for any of the purposes specified in paragraph (a). (3) The provisions of this Article shall not apply to any Bill introduced in the National Assembly or any motion moved in the National Assembly by a Minister or Deputy Minister.
